note: C-10. 18 badges (PRD P-5, Rules R_BADGE_COUNT). Codes are stable IDs and are stored in the Room table badge(code, earnedAt). A badge is earned once and never taken back. No badge depends on weight change, calorie deficit, very low intake or training volume above the WHO range (PRD PR-5). Messages: Indonesian, neutral, no kamu/Kak, at most one emoji, no weight or calorie judgement (Rules R_TONE, R_TONE_WORDS). Icon is a name from the mockup icon set (docs/mockups/mock.js); no assets.

metrics.finishedWorkouts: COUNT(workout WHERE endedAt IS NOT NULL). Fields: workout.endedAt.
metrics.personalRecords: COUNT of done workout_set rows (done = true, form = rapi or ragu, kind = normal) where, for the same exerciseId, weightKg is higher than every earlier done set (by doneAt), or weightKg is equal and reps is higher, or (no weightKg, no bandLevel) reps is higher. The first ever set of an exercise is a baseline, not a record. At most one record per exercise per workout (the best set). Fields: workout_set.exerciseId, weightKg, reps, done, doneAt, workoutId.
metrics.streakWeeks: Current streak length in weeks under Rules R_STREAK and R_STREAK_GRACE; a week (Monday to Sunday, local time) counts with at least 2 active days (a finished workout, an activity row, or a food_log day with at least 1 entry). Peak value is kept: the badge is earned when the value reaches the target at any time. Fields: workout.endedAt, activity.at, food_log.day.
metrics.activityMinutesWeek: Per calendar week (Monday to Sunday), SUM(activity.minutes) where effort = vigorous counts double (Rules section 4, S13). Fields: activity.minutes, activity.effort, activity.at.
metrics.targetWeeks: COUNT of weeks whose logged daily average kcal is within +-10 % of the day target and with at least 5 logged days (Rules R_PTS_TARGET). The same rows that create points_event kind = target. Fields: food_log.kcal, food_log.day, points_event.kind.
metrics.scheduledMeasures: COUNT(points_event WHERE kind = measure) (measure taken on the scheduled day, Rules R_PTS_MEASURE). Any measure type counts, never the value. Fields: points_event.kind, measure.takenAt.
metrics.returnAfterBreak: On a workout finish (workout.endedAt set), days between this endedAt and the previous finished workout's endedAt are at least 14. Fields: workout.endedAt.
metrics.level: Level from the sum of points_event.points against the thresholds in Rules R_LEVEL. Points never come from weight (R_PTS_NOWEIGHT). Fields: points_event.points.
metrics.plannedDays: For one weekStart, number of distinct meal_plan.day values with at least one row, out of 7. Fields: meal_plan.weekStart, meal_plan.day.
